Expert Roof Replacement You Can Trust

When your roof reaches the end of its lifespan or suffers severe damage from Texas hail and high winds, a simple repair is no longer enough. A full residential roof replacement is the ultimate way to secure your home's structural integrity.

At Core Four Roofing, our installation process goes far beyond just nailing down new shingles. We conduct a complete tear-off, inspect and repair your underlying wood decking, install premium waterproofing underlayments, and upgrade your attic ventilation. Whether you are upgrading to architectural shingles, standing seam metal, or synthetic slate, we deliver a flawless installation that boosts your curb appeal and provides decades of reliable protection.

item.html: Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Replacements
item.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Replacements

items.q: How do I know if I need a full replacement?
items.a: Our experts provide honest, photo-documented inspections. If your shingles are curling, losing significant granules, or if your roof is experiencing multiple leaks, a replacement is usually the best solution.

items.q: Can you install a new roof over my old one?
items.a: While a 'layover' is sometimes possible, we highly recommend a full tear-off. Removing old materials allows us to inspect your wood decking for hidden rot and ensures your new roof is installed perfectly.

items.q: Will a new roof lower my energy bills?
items.a: Yes! A new roof often includes upgraded ventilation and highly reflective materials, which drastically reduce the heat trapped in your attic and lower your summer cooling costs.

items.q: Do you help with insurance claims?
items.a: Absolutely. We have extensive experience with storm damage recovery. We provide detailed damage reports and work directly with your insurance adjuster to ensure your replacement is fully funded.
